info.name: AeroDataBox API - Aviation and Flight Aircraft API Industry API API
AeroDataBox FAA LADD Aircraft Status / TIER 3

items.docs:
*Returns:* The **current** status of the specified aircraft in the Limiting Aircraft Displayed program
of the Federal Aviation Administration of the U.S. Department of Transportation (FAA LADD). 
The industry list of blocked aircraft is synchrornized weekly with the FAA. 
More information about FAA LADD: https://www.faa.gov/pilots/ladd

**DISCLAIMER.** This endpoint is designed to provide easy access to verification against the FAA LADD industry list.
